cards.back: TTFT: latency until first token (prefill-heavy). TPOT: generation speed after streaming starts—users feel both.
Reuse attention keys/values for prior tokens so decode steps don’t recompute the full prefix—critical for long prompts and chat.
Reuse KV for identical long prefixes across requests—cuts cost and TTFT for repeated system/RAG blocks.
Lower precision weights/activations → less memory and higher throughput, possible quality loss—validate on your eval.
Grouping dynamic requests to raise GPU utilization without waiting for identical sequence lengths.
Prefill processes the prompt in parallel; decode generates one (or few) tokens at a time—different bottlenecks.
